name: transaction rows confirm themselves one by one
looks: A list of transaction rows, each with a vendor name and a signed amount, sits in a dark card; beside each one a small green check and a short confirmation tag pop in a beat apart, top to bottom.
build: glass-ui-flow's list-confirm pattern: each row's check badge pops in on back.out with a staggered 0.1-0.15 s delay per row, its tag fading in right behind it.
sound: A soft tick per row as its check lands.
prompt: List a column of transaction or record rows, each with a label and a signed amount, and let a small check badge and confirmation tag pop in beside each one in turn, top to bottom. Use it to show tedious reconciliation happening automatically, row by row.
